metadata.methods_description: Two participants per session were recorded simultaneously into one LSL/XDF file. Modalities include BioSemi high-density EEG (512 Hz, one recording at 2048 Hz), a 43-channel EMG neckband, PhaseSpace motion capture (480 Hz), head-mounted eye-tracking, AMTI force plates, and Xbox controller input. Task events derive from SNAP/LSE software markers and are HED-annotated. Recordings were converted to BIDS and re-partitioned into per-block and per-lull files.
